acceptance_criterion: The owning organiser and the assigned coordinator can edit event purpose, description, accessibility notes, and contact details while the event is in status Approved, Planning, or Confirmed
test_name: lets the owning organiser edit the four descriptive fields, recording each change (G1-T1, G1-T7)

acceptance_criterion: The significant fields (event date, start/end time, expected attendance, venue requirements, and equipment requirements) are not editable on this screen; attempting to edit them directs the user to the change-request process and stores no value
test_name: refuses an edit that includes a significant field, naming each, and stores nothing (G1-T6)

acceptance_criterion: Each saved edit records the editing user, the timestamp, and the before and after value of each changed field
test_name: lets the assigned coordinator edit, and records only the fields that changed (G1-T2, G1-T7)

acceptance_criterion: An edit attempted by a user who is neither the owner nor the assigned coordinator is refused and stores no value and no history entry
test_name: refuses anyone but the owner or the assigned coordinator, and stores nothing (G1-T8, G1-T9)

acceptance_criterion: If the save fails, no field is changed and no history entry is written
test_name: writes nothing at all when the save fails part-way (G1-T10)
